statement: For a regular local hypersurface there is an additive map from the stable maximal-Cohen-Macaulay Grothendieck group to the actual C2 Swan generic kernel, given by the sigma-plus-factorization involution
depends_on: C-Eisenbud1980 Theorem6.1 and Corollary6.3; explicit length-one horseshoe argument
notes: No injectivity or retraction claim. The constructed lattice has an acyclic Tate complex.

statement: The specified standard rank-four matrix-factorization lattice on every exponent-three dyadic node with ramification index at least two has class twice trivial plus sign, although it is Tate-acyclic and nonprojective
depends_on: C:MF-Swan-transfer; explicit ideal exact sequences; polynomial anticommuter
notes: Vanishing of one specified class, not a classification or polynomiality theorem for the node. Both localized polynomial and formal nodes, arbitrary unit coefficients.
